title: Split-Zero Geometry and Common Deformation Registers: Project Atlas, Exact Results, Formalization, and Visualizations
description:
This is the human-readable public home for a continuing mathematics project connecting explicit Erdos--Strauss arithmetic registers, split-zero and tagged-sedenion models, finite moonshine and Sigma(2,3,5) calculations, exact formal checks, and selected geometric experiments. The Project Atlas separates exact theorems, checked calculations, generated constructions, obstructions, diagnostics, and genuinely open interfaces.

The payload includes a 195-page bookmarked result-packet compendium, Lean and Python sources, proof-status and axiom audits, machine-readable ledgers, editable working texts, visual sources, scene data, and replay/QA material. A release-level reference-closure gate requires every generated result named in the public atlas to have its proof, checker, ledger, or replay artifact in this same payload; the 2026-07-18 correction restores Packet 076 and its source-crosswalk evidence because Packet 077 cites it.

Status. This is a working research record, not peer review, not a completed universal framework, and not a proof of a famous open problem. Conversational hunches are not promoted to conjectures, and known-failing maps are recorded as obstructions rather than conditional theorems. No JT-authored corpus dump is included; ownership and provenance boundaries are documented in the release.
notes: The 2026-07-18 correction restores Packet 076 and its source-crosswalk evidence and requires the Packet 201 finite-algebra Lean implementation, human facade, axiom audit, ledger, and report. The Project Atlas PDF is the recommended entry point. Full results are in the bookmarked compendium; proof and machine material is in the structured ZIP archives. The concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20822444 resolves to the latest version.
